trusted_float.trust: Five native primitive contracts are assumed; bodies are not verified.

trusted_simd.trust: Eleven fixed-size SIMD integer operation contracts and CPU dispatch are trusted; bodies are not verified.

boundary: Local executable adapter decisions verified; C varargs, pointer validity, ownership/event completeness, callbacks and whole-pipeline composition remain unverified.

evidence_scope.positive_proof: verification.json and verification-summary.json record the final complete source; full-proof.log is that run.
evidence_scope.parallel_run: The parallel receipt and full-proof-gate.log establish all negative gates. Their initial positive run predates final output initialization and is superseded by the final complete proof.
